# Blog Guidelines — Thor Metal Art

## Scope
Covers TICKET-WP-010 (Blog setup & content templates). Tests: `tests/test-wp-036` through `tests/test-wp-043`.

## Template Structure
- **Single post:** `templates/single.html` — article header, content, sidebar, back-link
- **Archive:** `templates/archive-*.html` — post grid, pagination, filter by category
- **Sidebar:** `parts/sidebar-blog.html` — recent posts, categories, CTA widget

## FSE Block Theme Patterns
- Parent theme: twentytwentyfive — use `<!-- wp:` block markup only
- Reuse patterns from `patterns/` (e.g., `cta-banner.php`, `service-card.php`)
- Register new blog patterns in `functions.php` via `register_block_pattern()`
- Custom post types use prefix `tma_` (e.g., `tma_portfolio`)

## Bilingual Content (EN/ES)
- All template labels translatable: `esc_html__( 'Read more', 'thormetalart' )`
- Text domain: `thormetalart`
- Slug translations handled via Polylang (if installed) or manual hreflang in `<head>`

## Blog Post Categories
- Use standard WordPress categories; slug prefix `tma-` not required for taxonomies
- Featured image required for archive grid layout (`has_post_thumbnail()` check)

## Sidebar Widgets
- Sidebar registered in `functions.php` via `register_sidebar()`
- Must remain functional when no widgets are added (graceful empty state)
- CTA widget must link to `/contacto` and use branding accent color `#B8860B`

## Performance
- No inline scripts in block templates — enqueue via `wp_enqueue_script()`
- Archive pages must use WP Query loop block, not custom `WP_Query`
- Excerpt length capped at 30 words via `excerpt_length` filter in `functions.php`

## SEO
- Blog archive title tag: `{Site Name} — Blog`
- Single post: Yoast/RankMath meta title = post title + ` | Thor Metal Art`
- No duplicate content — canonical tags auto-generated by SEO plugin

## Testing
Run `make test-wp` or scope with individual test scripts:
```bash
bash tests/test-wp-036-blog-setup.sh
bash tests/test-wp-037-blog-single-template.sh
bash tests/test-wp-038-blog-archive-template.sh
bash tests/test-wp-039-blog-seed-posts.sh
bash tests/test-wp-040-blog-sidebar.sh
bash tests/test-wp-042-blog-nav.sh
bash tests/test-wp-043-blog-translations.sh
```
